title: 第17章 钟离珟找人勾引昭杺柠第18章 涂辞珩的深情告白
slug: 绑定惹祸系统我被六个男主追杀
content_zh:
因为归云城靠近妖族领地的边界，从问天宗出发需要四个时辰。
所以问天宗安排了飞舟，方便弟子出行。
“小师婶，这是你的房间号。”
负责发放飞舟房间号的，正是昨天帮昭杺柠说话的那位弟子，名叫孙筘流。
“谢谢。”昭杺柠伸手正要接，身旁的钟离珟先她一步将她的房间号拿走。
“干嘛，你的房间号你不是已经拿了吗？”昭杺柠狐疑蹙眉。
“我们换一下。”钟离珟自顾自将两人的号码互换。
看着属于自己的6号牌被换成了钟离珟的7号牌，昭杺柠不解：“飞舟上的房间不都一样吗，有什么可换的？”
对于昭杺柠的疑惑，钟离珟没有解答，而是露出一抹高深莫测的笑来。
“神经。”昭杺柠当即白眼送上。
这是一艘小型飞舟，里面一共十四个房间，分别为两边各七间。
一开始，钟离珟的房间在7号，昭杺柠的房间为6号。
可现在经过钟离珟一调换，昭杺柠房间7号，钟离珟房间变到6号去了。
而且7号和8号房间，都是靠近飞舟尾部。
如果住在这7号和8号房间的弟子想要出门，必然会经过另外的10个房间。
但昭杺柠的思路根本没往这方面想。
她盯着属于自己的房间在飞舟最后面，目光幽幽看着钟离珟推开6号房间，昭杺柠快步跟了进去。
“你的房间在七号。”钟离珟提醒。
昨晚将卧室让给昭杺柠，害得他在主厅打坐过得一点都不舒服。
钟离珟还想趁着在飞舟的这几个时辰，好好打坐静静心。

而且昭杺柠被他特意安排在最里面的房间。
如果昭杺柠中途出去，钟离珟也能随时发现。
“房间都分好了，还要跟我互相调换。”昭杺柠挤开钟离珟先他一步进入6号房四处打量：“难道6号的配置比7号更豪华舒适？”
可是昭杺柠看了一圈，发现6号并没有什么特别的。
只有一张打坐的床，一桌四凳，外加一个阳台。
“也没什么特别的嘛。”
昭杺柠参观完6号房有些失望，啧了钟离珟一声，转而去到自己的7号房。
7号房同样的配置，跟6号房唯一不同的是，7号房多了一间浴室。
“呦呵。”昭杺柠顿时喜了起来。
“看你的样子很不满意跟我交换房间啊。”钟离珟也跟着她来到7号，笑道：“要不我俩还是将房间换回来吧。”
“落子无悔，你换都换了哪还能再要回去！”昭杺柠冷哼。
“主要是刚刚跟你换房间，你的反应很勉强。”钟离珟手推着昭杺柠房门，说着就要进屋：“我们还是将房间换回来吧。”
“不行！”昭杺柠在屋内双手推关门，还伸腿将钟离珟迈进屋的脚踢了出去：“退退退！这个房间是我的了，我要睡觉了，再见！”
说着，昭杺柠大了力气，直接将钟离珟推出房间，连忙将房门关上，并且落了反锁。
“很好，有浴室的房间归我了，嘿嘿。”成功赶走钟离珟，昭杺柠背靠房门满脸笑意。
被关在屋外的钟离珟唇角刚刚扬起，就听见孙筘流惊叹的声音：“小师叔，您被小师婶赶出房间了啊？”
content_en:
Because Guiyun City is close to the border of the Monster Clan's territory, it takes four hours to set off from Wentian Sect.
Therefore, Wentian Sect arranged a flying boat to facilitate the disciples' travel.
"Little Auntie, this is your room number."
The person responsible for issuing Feizhou room numbers is the disciple who spoke to Zhao Haining yesterday, named Sun Jinliu.
"Thank you." Zhao Haining reached out and was about to take it, but Zhong Lizui beside her took her room number away first.
"What are you doing? Didn't you already get your room number?" Zhao Hao Ning frowned suspiciously.
"Let's change it." Zhong Lizuo exchanged their numbers.
Seeing that her No. 6 card was replaced by Zhong Lizui's No. 7 card, Zhao Hao Ning was puzzled: "Aren't the rooms on the flying boat all the same? Is there anything to change?"
Regarding Zhao Haining's doubts, Zhong Lizui did not answer, but showed an enigmatic smile.
"Nervous." Zhao Hao Ning immediately rolled her eyes.
This is a small flying boat with a total of fourteen rooms inside, seven on each side.
At the beginning, Zhong Lizui's room was at No. 7, and Zhao Hao Ning's room was at No. 6.
But now, after Zhongli Sui changed it, Zhao Hao Ning's room was No. 7, and Zhongli Sui's room was changed to No. 6.
Moreover, rooms No. 7 and No. 8 are located near the rear of the flying boat.
If the disciples living in rooms 7 and 8 want to go out, they will inevitably pass by the other 10 rooms.
But Zhao Hao Ning didn't think about it at all.
She stared at her own room at the back of the flying boat, and watched Zhong Lizui push away Room 6 with a faint look, and Zhao Haining quickly followed in.
"Your room is on the seventh." Zhong Lizui reminded.
Last night, he gave up his bedroom to Zhao Hao Ning, which made him feel uncomfortable at all while meditating in the main hall.
Zhong Lizui also wanted to take advantage of these few hours in Feizhou to meditate and calm his mind.
Moreover, Zhao Hao Ning was specially placed in the innermost room by him.
If Zhao Hao Ning goes out in the middle, Zhong Lizui can find it at any time.
"The rooms have been divided, and I have to switch with each other." Zhao Haoning pushed Zhong Lizui aside and entered Room 6 before him and looked around: "Is the configuration of Room 6 more luxurious and comfortable than that of Room 7?"
But Zhao Haining looked around and found that there was nothing special about No. 6.
There is only a bed for meditation, a table and four stools, and a balcony.
"It's nothing special."
After visiting Room 6, Zhao Haining was a little disappointed. She tutted at Zhong Lizui and went to her own Room 7.
Room 7 has the same configuration as Room 6. The only difference from Room 6 is that Room 7 has an extra bathroom.
"Hey." Zhao Hao Ning suddenly became happy.
"You look very dissatisfied with switching rooms with me." Zhong Lizou followed her to No. 7 and said with a smile, "How about we change rooms back."
"You have no regrets, you have already changed everything and you can still get it back!" Zhao Hao Ning snorted coldly.
"The main reason is that I just changed rooms with you and your reaction was very reluctant." Zhong Lizui pushed the door of Zhao Hao Ning's room with his hand and was about to enter the room: "Let's change the room back."
"No!" Zhao Haoning pushed the door shut with both hands inside the house, and stretched out her legs to kick out Zhongli Sui's feet as he entered the house: "Back off, back off! This room is mine. I'm going to bed. Goodbye!"
With that said, Zhao Haining used more strength to push Zhong Lizui out of the room, quickly closed the door and locked it.
"Very good, the room with the bathroom is mine, hehe." After successfully driving away Zhongli Sui, Zhao Haining leaned against the door with a smile on her face.
Zhong Lizui, who was locked out of the room, just raised the corners of his lips when he heard Sun Jinliu's exclamation voice: "Uncle Junior, were you driven out of the room by Junior Senior Aunt?"
